en-US.title: Status Original
en-US.subtitle: Encrypted chat, your own keys
en-US.description:
A messenger with no company in the middle.

Your account is a twelve-word recovery phrase held on your device. There is no sign-up, phone number, email address, or account on an application server.

WHAT IT DOES
• End-to-end encrypted chats over XMTP, Nostr, or Waku
• Replies, reactions, photos, files, GIFs, and voice messages
• A local Status room for help and plugin commands
• Optional payment, market, profile, bot, and dapp plugins
• Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, and supported hardware accounts

YOUR DATA
Recovery phrases and credentials remain on the device. Message history uses per-account encrypted databases. Contacts are read only when preparing an invitation and are never uploaded by the app.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
Nobody can reset your account. Write down the recovery phrase and keep it offline. If it is lost, the account cannot be recovered.
en-US.promoText: Encrypted messaging where the account is a key you hold. No phone number, no email, no server with your name on it.
